subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue be considered fixed by a focused persistent active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb, or should it remain open until the Dashboard also proves deeper live-target details such as session generation, input cursor, writable target, switch feedback, quick switch, or message prefixes?
rationale: The code path for the focused breadcrumb is clear, but the issue discussion expands into a broader multi-agent safety contract that automation should not silently scope down or expand without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept focused breadcrumb
options.body: Land or replace the focused workspace breadcrumb PR and track deeper live-target proof and optional controls separately.

options.title: Broaden this issue before close
options.body: Require the implementation to cover the larger session-generation, cursor, writable-target, and switch-feedback tuple before closing this issue.

options.title: Reject header expansion
options.body: Decline persistent header context in core and keep the existing /agent, /status, and workspace rail workflow as the supported path.

recommendation.title: Accept focused breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Land or replace the focused workspace breadcrumb PR and track deeper live-target proof and optional controls separately.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev introduced the current active-agent header context that this product decision would extend or constrain.
